decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (JK/21 received 03.12.10 and JK/20C received 20.04.11) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear or flank walls of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The detached single-storey outbuilding must only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house known as number 96 Windmill Road and for no other purpose. A purpose incidental to a dwelling house would not cover normal residential uses, such as separate self-contained accommodation nor the use of an outbuilding for primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, or kitchen.
description: Retention of a single storey outbuilding in the rear garden of the house.
